implementation_summary: Valid sole compact_context now ends with chat.done carrying the authentic tool_call only (no tool_result); COMPACT_CONTEXT_ACK removed. MetaEventKind gains compaction (server + client). The client appends one meta/compaction harness step (data.forkConversationId) to the original after its chat.done steps and before the fork enters state, selects the fork and, per the scope extension, sends nothing for it (auto-send, withoutCompactContext, fork contextRequest and handoff settledCount bump removed; the original settles once in its finally). The card renders as an app-event meta card with a link selecting the fork, plain stored text when the fork is missing or the data malformed. placeStepsForModel omits unanswered compact_context calls (same id; id-less: same name after) and the harness step; rejected calls with error results are still sent.
decisions: Executor fallback execute() returns a literal string instead of the removed ACK constant.
Link text uses the live fork title; the stored content keeps the creation-time title and is shown when no link applies.
PlacementStep gains an optional structural metaEvent.kind so the harness step is recognised without a type import.
Header label for the card is 'app event: compaction'.

AC-STRUCT-6 property rewritten: forkExpected iff compaction done applied while original owned the generation; no stream for the fork; original settles once; exactly one harness step after the done steps.
